title: Fixed Empty Grooved Rims and Open Temple Trial Frame
description: One wholly newly authored complete empty trial-spectacle-frame exterior, not an optical or medical device. Two thick open circular carriers have genuine internal annular seating recesses and are joined to one complete horizontal bridge rail by bored upper collars. A central stem supports two separate nose-pad appearances, while full outer hinge blocks carry two whole long rearward temple arms with curved dropped ends. Small blank bridge controls belong to this complete open frame. All vertices new; no old ocular housing or stand is imported. Unlike the complete phoropter-style head there are no thick flattened instrument housings, lower dial banks, hanging post or floor base; unlike the full slit-lamp table there is no headrest gantry, central binocular barrel or illumination column. The complete rim/bridge/nose/temple organization is the distinction, not fewer sight holes. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, horizontal bounds centred and grounded, one model zero scenes. Empty fixed static exterior only: no lenses, transparent glass, prescription or vision testing, adjustment, measurement, patient, wearability, facial fit, manufacture, medical operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
